description: Seeded contradiction: Competitor marketing claims permanent free tier, but pricing terms state paid enterprise only.
document: Effective September 2025, DataStream has completely eliminated the free developer tier and requires a minimum $1,000 monthly commitment for API access.

expected.claim_text: DataStream provides a permanent free tier for developer API access.
